title: tests: re-cite stale spec lines in chat, did tests
description:
Stale spec citations in test oracles (chat, filenode, did). Line numbers below are identical at jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 and HEAD 33702a5. Assertions are correct; only the cited oracle text/lines are stale. Batch 8b review (JMAP-0x0q.5/.7/.11/.14/.41).

- crate-jmap-chat-filenode-server/tests/root_create.rs: header L4 still names 0cd3af0; L9/L11/L14 and test docs L129-189 cite L128/L130/L131/L132, but draft-atwood-jmap-chat-filenode-00 now has root creation at L139, membership L141, one-root L142, permission L143. Same drift in tests/quota_autocreate.rs (header L5, L108/L111/L116/L138 cites at L7-18, L86-154) and tests/space_deletion.rs (L99 L199/L115).
- crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs:163-165: mixes unpinned `L177-199` with `6bcd9d8 L197-203`; metadata keys are at draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00 L200-203.
- crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/space_smoke_tests.rs:830: says Design Tokens `$value` is "in CSS Color 4 syntax"; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L302 now says a color object, "not a CSS color string" (the vector below was already updated).
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/presence_delivery.rs:71-75, 107-109: quote removed MUST wording ("server MUST deliver offline...", "Servers MUST NOT deliver ChatPresenceEvent"); draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 L275 and L300 now read "\"invisible\" is not a value of this field" / "a ChatPresenceEvent is not delivered". Cites wss:269/293 are stale.
- crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/typing_delivery.rs:125-128, 148-149: quote "Servers MUST verify ... MUST be dropped silently"; wss-00 L255 says SHOULD for both.
- crate-jmap-did-types/tests/resolve.rs:470: cites draft-atwood-jmap-chat-did-00 L252 for "inconsistent"; text is at L279 (the test above at L412 was already re-cited).
- crate-jmap-did-resolver/tests/resolver.rs:472: 'did-00 L150 names "HTTP 4xx/5xx"'; draft-atwood-jmap-did-00 L150 is blank, the text is at L189.
- crate-jmap-base-client/tests/did_capability.rs:90: keyCustody cited as L151; it is draft-atwood-jmap-did-00 L195.
